title: Reading a recorded list entry
statement: Let $\mu:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$, and suppose a list $l$ of length $N$ records the values of $\mu$ at the consecutive indices starting at $a$, with $a+N\le\mathrm{top}$. For every $i<N$, the value $\mu(a+i)$ equals the list entry at index $i$; equivalently, it equals the default-zero lookup of $l$ at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: l records μ on the segment starting at a
